Morgan L.: Quick sync — we're rolling RBAC changes next week. Need to confirm audit event coverage + schema changes and how customer-facing audit validation will work. Also worried about KMS per-event overhead and index costs at high throughput. Any blockers?

Sasha R.: Can you list which new events will be emitted? We need schema versioning for downstream parsers. Customer-facing events must have stable fields.

Devin K.: From load tests, ingest pipeline peaked at 18k eps with 30% latency spikes when per-event KMS encrypt + index refresh happened. We should batch KMS or use envelope keys.

Arjun P.: Agree. Proposal: sign events synchronously, encrypt payloads with a per-shard envelope key rotated daily. KMS only used to wrap/unwrap envelope keys during rotation.

Arjun P.: ```
# pseudo
envelope_key = get_wrapped_key(kms_key_id)  # unwrap occasionally
for batch in batches(events, size=256):
   payload = batch_compress(batch)
   ciphertext = encrypt(envelope_key, payload)
   write_to_ingest(ciphertext, meta)
```

Olivia M.: We also need to ensure no customer PII ends up in audit stream. Add redaction step in pipeline and mark events with schema_v field. Also add a validation webhook for customers who opt-in to event forwarding.

Sasha R.: Schema example?

Sasha R.: ```
{
  "schema_v": "2",
  "ts": "...",
  "actor": {"id":"user-123","role":"admin"},
  "action":"grant_role",
  "resource":"project:alpha",
  "metadata":{"changes":[...] }
}
```

Devin K.: On batching: we can do 128-512 per batch. Need backpressure signals from ES indexing — when ES queue > 75% throttle producers. Also consider TTL-based cold storage to cut index costs.

sec-bot: Incident runbook: https://internal/runbooks/audit-ingest-backpressure — recommended circuit breaker params: queue_threshold=0.7, shed_rate=0.5.

Morgan L.: OK action items: (1) Arjun prototype envelope key rotation + batch encrypt, (2) Sasha produce schema diff doc and customer-facing validation contract, (3) Devin run load test with batch sizes 128/256 and capture KMS calls, (4) Olivia define redaction rules and PII checklist. I'll coordinate with legal for customer notifications. Who can take ownership of (3)?

Devin K.: I'll own (3). ETA EOD Friday for initial numbers.

Arjun P.: I'll spike (1) — need a short perm to create kms key. @Olivia M. can you confirm PII fields list?

Olivia M.: Sending PII checklist shortly.
